Frame-count ablation · gap-aware Chamfer (Accuracy / Completeness / F1)

How many photos does the reconstruction need? — information_sign_002_test_1 (3 methods) & bollard_003_test_1 (2 methods), 4 sizes each

Nested subsets, per object: information_sign_002_test_1 uses N=25/50/75/100, bollard_003_test_1 uses N=15/30/45/60 — each object's own smaller N is a strict subset of its next size up, same underlying hand-picked coverage ranking (manually ordered by the user, not the SIFT-overlap greedy algorithm used elsewhere in this project — see each object's pool_*/frame_list.txt), just longer prefixes, so the four sizes are directly comparable within an object (no re-randomized pick between them). The two objects' N values are not comparable to each other directly (the "basic curves" section below plots N/N_max instead of raw N for that reason). Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.
